sparkline-view.description: Label-less miniature trend line for KPI cards: semantic stroke color from the trend, gaps skipped, keyboard-free.

examples.note: Rising reads as success, falling as danger. Direction is also in the accessible label — color is never the only signal.

kpis.note: KPI cards with delta badges and trend sparklines, migrated from the chart shell. Deltas use semantic badges; direction is also stated in the sparkline label.

gaps.note: Null and undefined points break the line instead of interpolating. An empty input renders an empty frame that still carries its label.

card.note: KPI trio on solaris-card: title, value, delta badge and sparkline. Badge color follows deltaDirection crossed with positiveIsGood; direction stays in the accessible label.

size-density.note: Size and density combine into a 3×3 matrix: sm shrinks hero and canvas, lg grows them, md is the default. Density refines legend gaps and stroke weight.

states.note: Empty data renders an empty frame with its accessible label. Sparklines have no loading or error visuals — the KPI card owns those states.

installation.note: Install the package and import the standalone sparkline component.

props.note: Inputs and defaults. Sparklines are presentational: no outputs, no keyboard stops, no tooltip.
